source_refs.note: Topic 11.5, printed pages 250-252: lymph vessels and lymph, the functions of the lymphatic system, lymph nodes and lymphoid masses.

blocks.text: In human, in addition to the blood circulatory system, there is another system responsible for the transport of materials. It also returns the materials from tissues to blood. This system is called lymphatic system. It consists of lymph vessels, lymphoid masses, lymph nodes and lymph-the fluid which flows in the system.
